title: ETTP Policy
description: A versioned declarative rule describing an effect and deterministic conditions; this schema does not evaluate policy.

field.description: The data field to which the condition applies.

operator.description: An extensible deterministic comparison operator identifier.

value.description: A JSON value compared by the condition. Its operator-specific interpretation belongs to a later policy-engine sprint.

effect.description: The declarative outcome associated with this policy when its conditions match.

conditions.description: Deterministic condition records. Interpretation and evaluation are outside Sprint 1.

extensions.description: Optional implementation-defined extension data. Extensions must not redefine ETTP protocol fields.
